name: cobol-root-scope-module-name-clash
body: rooted_scope roots a cobol scope parent under cobol.. only when no known non-empty module identity prefixes it and the empty root module is known, using the longest-prefix walk shared with root_edge_endpoint. Limit: a root-level program or class whose name equals a subdirectory module identity roots under that module instead of the root. Upgrade by passing the scanning file's module with each scope if such a clash appears.
